Personality: Guran is a contradictory and inscrutable Battanian lord. Influenced by his cruel mother Moirias, he conducts clan affairs with coldness and stinginess, remaining aloof even toward close friends and rarely granting favors. On the battlefield, however, he displays a rare mercy, frequently sparing defeated foes—a pattern of 'leniency abroad, severity at home' that makes him a subject of controversy in noble circles. Caring nothing for hollow fame, he prefers to solve practical problems with the longbow and greatsword in his hands. Years of life in the mountain forests have tempered his will, making him an extraordinary hunter and guerrilla tactician. Knowing well how fragile internal power in Battania truly is, he maintains a cautious distance even while serving High King Caladog, standing as a pragmatic and solitary watcher.
Background: Guran hails from the prominent Battanian clan of Fen Caernacht and grew up in the rugged fastness of Ab Comer Castle. As the son of Clan Leader Moirias and Rhodarach, he learned to survive from childhood beneath his mother's dark and cunning political machinations. Despite his family's illustrious standing, he prefers honing his archery and physical endurance in the mist-shrouded woods to exchanging hollow pleasantries at feasts. As clashes between the Battanian tribes, the Empire, and neighboring realms intensify, Guran has become a vital pillar of his clan along the frontier through his exceptional scouting skills and tactical acumen. Having witnessed the High King's efforts to centralize authority, he also knows the untamed spirit in the bones of Battania's chieftains. Under his mother Moirias's iron-fisted rule, he fulfills his oaths to Caladog as a lord, striving to find a balance between ruthless power struggles and his own moral code while defending his family's lands.
